# Review Instructions

Review shared workflow changes as supply chain changes affecting many caller repositories.

Prioritize permission escalation, unsafe fork behavior, secret exposure, command injection, unpinned actions, unsupported GitHub-plan assumptions, unstable check names, destructive migrations, broken reusable workflow inputs, and missing release verification.

Verify findings against the workflow event, caller permissions, GitHub capability boundaries, tests, and documentation. Do not request stylistic changes without a concrete correctness or maintenance impact.
